entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Alex with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while back. I bought a jersey, but it turns out I got the wrong size.
I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0921. I finally got around to trying it on for a ride and it's just too tight across the chest. I was hoping I could exchange it.

Okay, one moment. I'm pulling up VF886-0921 now... Yes, I see the Pro-Cycle jersey purchased 54 days ago. You are absolutely within our 90-day return window, so processing an exchange is no problem at all.
Oh, that's great news. So I can just send this one back for the next size up?
That's right. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account right now. You can use that to send the jersey back, and once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size.

Perfect, thank you. Now, I do see you have a winter gear sale coming up, and since I am a VIP member and have to go through the hassle of this return, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase?

I see you're one of our top-tier members, and I'd be happy to do that for you. For the inconvenience, I've just applied a 15% credit to your account that will be automatically used on your next order. How does that sound?
That sounds fantastic. I appreciate you doing that, Alex. That makes the whole process much easier.
Of course. We value your business. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
